pack.name: Bangladeshi newspapers
pack.description: Public feeds of Bangladeshi national, regional and online newspapers, TV news sites and the national news agency, in Bangla and English, plus BBC News Bangla and DW Bangla.
pack.notes: Each feed was fetched and parsed on 17 November 2026 with robots.txt checked. One feed per site: an RSS feed or Google News sitemap where one is current; otherwise a plain sitemap whose newest pages are stories, with page metadata lookup turned on to read their headlines. Not included: sites that block automated access (Kaler Kantho, Bangladesh Pratidin, Kalbela, Jagonews24, RisingBD, Daily Sun, Manobkantha, Jaijaidin, Somoy News); sites that refuse feed requests or list only section pages (Protidiner Sangbad, RTV, Bangladesh Journal, Dhaka Times, Alokito Bangladesh, Bonik Barta, The Financial Express, DBC News); sites with no feed or sitemap (UNB, Bangladesh Post, The Asian Age, Ajkaler Khobor, The Daily Messenger, Dhaka Courier, ATN Bangla, Bangla Vision, Bangladesh Betar, Share Biz, Dainik Mathabhanga, Comillar Kagoj); feeds that stopped updating (Naya Diganta's sitemaps end on 8 November 2026; NTV, VOA Bangla, The Daily Star Bangla, Maasranga, Juger Alo); and sites whose robots.txt could not be read or disallows access (Daily Sangram, BTV, Deepto TV, The Independent, Bangla Insider, Poriborton, Live Narayanganj and some regional papers).
